name: Scorching Ray
summary: Hurls three fiery rays that each deal Fire damage on a hit.

stats.effect: You hurl three fiery rays. You can hurl them at one target within range or at several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage.
stats.higherLevels: You create one additional ray for each spell slot level above 2.
